THEATRE REVIEW GUYS AND DOLLS

Saturday, June 05, 1993

ROBERT CUSHMAN

Toronto ONT -- WRITTEN BY FRANK LOESSER, JO SWERLING AND ABE BURROWS Directed by Jerry Zaks Starring Lorna Luft, Lewis J. Stadlen, Richard Muenz and Patricia Ben Peterson At the Royal Alexandra Theatre Rating: Damon Runyon it ain't. But Guys and Dolls is worth a look, especially if you never see the show before Sit down, sit down, sit down... BY ROBERT CUSHMAN Special to The Globe and Mail Toronto THERE are many citizens who believe that Guys and Dolls is the best musical comedy that is ever written, and personally I do not disagree. In fact, I hold this opinion since long before I ever see the show, as I grow up listening to the original cast recording, and in fact I play this disc so often that I wear it out and have to buy a replacement, although such extravagance is by no means my custom.
